ابتعثت (form VIII)
# اِبْتَعَثْتُ (ibtaʕaṯtu) /ib.ta.ʕaθ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اِبْتَعَثْتَ (ibtaʕaṯta) /ib.ta.ʕaθ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اِبْتَعَثْتِ (ibtaʕaṯti) /ib.ta.ʕaθ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# اِبْتَعَثَتْ (ibtaʕaṯat) /ib.ta.ʕa.θat/: third-perso
